 In Brief
 警方今天（24日）中午发通告表示，早前下落不明的24岁女子Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan已被寻获。
 警方是在昨天（23日）发文告，呼吁公众提供有关Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan下落的线索。
 《8视界新闻网》早前报道，她最后一次被人看见是在前天（22日）晚上大约8点。
 Missing 24-year-old woman found 
 Police said in a notice issued at noon today (Oct 24) that 24-year-old woman Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan, who had earlier been reported missing, has been found.
 Police issued a statement yesterday (Oct 23) appealing for information on the whereabouts of Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan.
 8World News had earlier reported that she was last seen at about 8pm the day before yesterday (Oct 22).

 警方今天（24日）中午发通告表示，早前下落不明的24岁女子Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan已被寻获。
 警方是在昨天（23日）发文告，呼吁公众提供有关Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan下落的线索。
 《8视界新闻网》早前报道 ，她最后一次被人看见是在前天（22日）晚上大约8点。她当时身穿黑色短袖T恤和黑色长裤，地点是在兀兰16通道第577座组屋（Block 577 Woodlands Drive 16）附近。
